title: Parse: Extract requirements from Channel Agility
description:
Read spec section, extract MUST/SHALL/SHOULD statements, create checklist in task description

## Extracted Requirements from 02a-coordinated-capacity.md Section 2a.3

### Channel Agility (2a.3.1)

- [ ] MUST: All nodes MUST listen continuously on CH0 for DIOs and beacons
- [ ] MUST: All implementations MUST produce identical results to test vectors in ccp16.json, ccp9*.json, ccp_load_balancing.json
- [ ] MUST: All subtractions/comparisons/MOD operations MUST use unsigned 32-bit modular arithmetic (modulo 2^32) for wraparound

### SelectChannel Procedure

- [ ] MUST: IF Density > 8 THEN RETURN 0 (fallback to CH0)
- [ ] MUST: Data = CONCAT(EUI64 as BE bytes, Epoch as LE u32 bytes)
- [ ] MUST: Hash = FNV1A32(Data) with basis 0x811c9dc5
- [ ] MUST: N = MAX(NChannels, 3)
- [ ] MUST: RETURN 1 + (Hash MOD N)

### Adaptive SF Selection (2a.7)

- [ ] REQUIRED: SF10 is the REQUIRED baseline for moderate density (5-20 nodes)
- [ ] MUST: Load_factor from gateway DIOs takes precedence
- [ ] MUST: All paths MUST match ccp16.json and ccp_load_balancing.json exactly

### AdaptiveSFSelect Procedure

- [ ] MUST: IF SF absent THEN SF = 10
- [ ] MUST: IF (Density > 10) OR (Utilization > 150) THEN SF = MIN(12, SF + 2)
- [ ] SHOULD: IF (Neighbor.EMA_SNR > 8) AND (Density < 5) THEN SF = MAX(7, SF - 1)
- [ ] MUST: IF (Neighbor.EMA_Loss > 0.25) OR (Utilization > 200) THEN SF = MIN(12, SF + 1)
- [ ] MUST: IF Utilization > 200 THEN RETURN (SF, false) -- tx not allowed

### SF Threshold Table (Downgrade = MUST, Upgrade = SHOULD)

- [ ] MUST: SF7 downgrade when SNR < 0 OR loss > 0.25
- [ ] SHOULD: SF9 upgrade when Density < 5 AND SNR_EMA > 8
- [ ] MUST: SF9 downgrade when SNR < 0 OR Density > 8
- [ ] MUST: SF10 downgrade when SNR < 0 OR load_factor > 0.8
- [ ] MUST: SF11 downgrade when Density > 8 OR SNR_EMA < 0 OR load > 0.8
- [ ] MUST: SF12 downgrade when Density > 20 OR SNR_EMA < -5

### EMA_Update

- [ ] MUST: EMA_Update(Avg, Sample) = Avg + ((Sample - Avg) right-shift 2) [alpha = 1/4]
- [ ] MUST: Update per-neighbor state on every RX
